title: TWO LUXURIOUS townhome🏅2 Rooftop/15 Beds/Sleep 20+
description:
SLEEPS 20 !!
The listed price includes two townhouses that are adjacent to each other. 

These are two highly sought-after, and luxurious townhomes!  two units featuring six bedrooms, six full bathrooms, fully equipped kitchens, and two spacious rooftops with breathtaking skylight views. 
We are confident that your group will find your Nashville vacation to be an exceptional and luxurious experience, making it a memorable addition to your trip.

The space
This townhome is just a few blocks away from the stunning Centennial Park and the iconic Parthenon. You’ll find a variety of new restaurants within walking distance, including Farm Burger, Calypso, Chaatable, Double Dogs, Sump Coffee, and Pastaria, among others.

Guest access
You’ll have access to the entire home. Before your stay, we’ll send you the access code along with the entry instructions. The host is always available to answer any questions or inquiries you may have. Thanks!

Other things to note
There’s a large dumpster located a few steps behind the alley entrance, behind the building.
